guide_intro: Welcome to the Accounting System! This guide helps you learn how to use all sections.
guide_sales_intro: In the Sales section you can create invoices, quotes, sales orders, and credit notes.
guide_sales_invoice_steps:
1. Go to Sales > Invoices
2. Click 'New'
3. Select customer — e.g. 'Ahmed Mohammed'
4. Add items — e.g. Dell Laptop at 1,200,000 IQD
5. Select tax — 15%
6. Total: 1,380,000 IQD
7. Save and send to customer
guide_sales_quote_steps:
1. Go to Sales > Quotes
2. Click 'New'
3. Fill in customer and item details
4. After customer approval, you can convert it to an invoice
guide_sales_order_steps:
1. Go to Sales > Sales Orders
2. Create a new order
3. When shipped, mark as shipped
guide_sales_credit_steps:
1. Go to Sales > Credit Notes
2. Select source invoice
3. Enter amount and reason for return
4. Credit is recorded on customer's account
guide_sales_recurring_steps:
1. Go to Sales > Recurring Invoices
2. E.g. Office rent 1,500,000 IQD monthly
3. Set recurrence cycle (monthly/weekly)
4. System automatically creates invoices
guide_purchases_intro: In the Purchases section you can record bills, purchase orders, expenses, and vendor credits.
guide_purchases_bill_steps:
1. Go to Purchases > Bills
2. Click 'New'
3. Select vendor — e.g. 'Techno Company'
4. Add items — e.g. 10 monitors at 300,000 IQD
5. Total: 3,000,000 IQD
6. Save
guide_purchases_po_steps:
1. Go to Purchases > Purchase Orders
2. Create a new order for vendor
3. When goods arrive, convert to bill
guide_purchases_expense_steps:
1. Go to Purchases > Expenses
2. Select expense type — e.g. Rent, Electricity, Phone
3. Enter amount and date
4. Description: 'Office rent for Month 1' — 2,000,000 IQD
guide_purchases_vendor_credit_steps:
When a vendor sends defective goods:
1. Go to Purchases > Vendor Credits
2. Select source bill
3. Enter return amount
guide_banking_intro: In this section you manage your bank accounts and record transactions.
guide_banking_account_steps:
1. Go to Banking > Accounts
2. Add new account — e.g. Current account at Kurdistan Bank
3. Enter name, account number, and currency
guide_banking_transaction_steps:
1. Go to Banking
2. Record a new transaction
3. Type: Deposit (money in) or Withdrawal (money out)
guide_banking_reconciliation_steps:
1. Get your bank statement
2. Go to Banking > Reconciliation
3. Match system transactions with statement entries
4. Complete matching entries
guide_accounting_intro: Accounting basics — accounts, entries, and reports.
guide_accounting_chart_steps:
Your accounts are categorized as:
• Assets — Cash, Bank, Inventory
• Liabilities — Loans, Payables
• Income — Sales, Services
• Expenses — Rent, Salaries, Electricity
• Equity — Owner's Equity
guide_accounting_journal_steps:
Double Entry System:
For example, when you pay 100,000 IQD rent:
• DR Rent Expense  100,000 IQD
• CR Cash          100,000 IQD
guide_accounting_reports_steps:
• P&L (Profit & Loss): Income vs Expenses
• Balance Sheet: Assets = Liabilities + Equity
• Trial Balance: All accounts with DR and CR
guide_accounting_tax_steps:
1. Go to Settings > Tax
2. Set tax rate — e.g. 15% VAT
3. Use in invoices
guide_inventory_item_steps:
1. Go to Items
2. Add new item — Name, SKU, purchase and selling price
3. E.g. Dell Laptop — SKU: DELL-001 — Selling price: 1,200,000 IQD
guide_inventory_warehouse_steps:
1. Go to Inventory > Warehouses
2. Add new warehouse — name and address
3. Transfer items from one warehouse to another
guide_inventory_adjustment_steps:
1. Go to Inventory > Adjustment
2. When actual quantity differs from system
3. Enter actual quantity — system records the difference
guide_projects_intro: Managing projects, tasks, and project billing.
guide_projects_create_steps:
1. Go to Projects
2. Create new project — name, customer, budget
3. E.g. Building a website for Awat Company — Budget: 5,000,000 IQD
guide_assets_intro: Recording fixed assets such as vehicles, equipment, and furniture.
guide_assets_create_steps:
1. Go to Fixed Assets
2. Record new asset — name, value, purchase date
3. Asset depreciation is calculated automatically
guide_settings_intro: System settings — profile, organization, security, backup.
guide_settings_profile_steps:
1. Go to Settings > Profile
2. Enter name and phone number
3. Change password

settings.help.fiscal.what: Fiscal years define the accounting periods for your organization.
settings.help.fiscal.why: You need at least one fiscal year before creating budgets or closing books.
settings.help.fiscal.step_1: Click 'New Fiscal Year' and enter a name (e.g. FY 2025).
settings.help.fiscal.step_2: Set the start and end dates to match your financial year.
settings.help.fiscal.step_3: Save — the year is now available for budgets and reports.
settings.help.currencies.what: Currencies lists all the currencies your organization can transact in.
settings.help.currencies.why: Multi-currency support lets you invoice customers and pay vendors in their local currency.
settings.help.currencies.step_1: Click 'Add Currency' and select the currency code from the list.
settings.help.currencies.step_2: Set the exchange rate relative to your base currency.
settings.help.currencies.step_3: Enable 'Auto-update rates' to fetch live rates daily.
settings.help.currencies.step_4: Save — the currency is now available on invoices and bills.
settings.help.budgets.what: Budgets let you plan and track expected income and expenses for a fiscal period.
settings.help.budgets.why: Comparing actuals against budgets helps you spot overspending and forecast cash flow.
settings.help.budgets.step_1: Select a fiscal year for the budget.
settings.help.budgets.step_2: Add budget lines for each account or cost center.
settings.help.budgets.step_3: Enter the planned amount for each period.
settings.help.budgets.step_4: Save and use the Budget vs Actual report to monitor performance.
settings.help.profile.what: Profile settings manage your personal account information including name and phone.
settings.help.profile.why: Keeping your profile updated ensures proper communication and security.
settings.help.profile.step_1: Edit your display name and phone number.
settings.help.profile.step_3: Use the password section to update your password.
settings.help.templates.what: Invoice templates control the layout and branding of your printed and PDF invoices.
settings.help.templates.why: Professional templates build trust and ensure your business details are clearly presented.
settings.help.templates.step_1: Click 'Create' to add a new template.
settings.help.templates.step_2: Choose a layout (classic, modern, minimal, or RTL) and customize colors.
settings.help.templates.step_3: Set one template as default for all new invoices.
settings.help.reminders.what: Automated reminders send emails to customers about upcoming and overdue invoice payments.
settings.help.reminders.why: Reminders reduce late payments and improve cash flow without manual follow-ups.
settings.help.reminders.step_1: Configure days before and after due date to send reminders.
settings.help.reminders.step_2: Customize the email subject and body templates.
settings.help.reminders.step_3: Enable the reminders toggle to activate automatic sending.
settings.help.einvoice.what: E-invoicing enables Iraq's electronic invoice portal (ZATCA) compliance for VAT reporting.
settings.help.einvoice.why: All taxable businesses in Iraq must generate and submit electronic invoices via the ZATCA portal.
settings.help.einvoice.step_1: Enable the portal and enter your seller Tax ID and branch code.
settings.help.einvoice.step_2: Upload your digital certificate private key and set API credentials.
settings.help.einvoice.step_3: Test the connection and monitor the compliance dashboard for submission status.
settings.help.modules.what: Modules enable or disable different business functionality in your ERP.
settings.help.modules.why: Enabling only needed modules keeps the interface clean and can reduce costs.
settings.help.modules.step_1: Click 'Re-run onboarding' to go through the setup wizard again.
settings.help.modules.step_2: Select your industry and choose which modules to enable.
settings.help.modules.step_3: Complete onboarding to apply the new module configuration.
settings.help.taxes.what: Taxes defines the tax rates and groups applied to sales and purchase transactions.
settings.help.taxes.why: Correct tax configuration ensures accurate VAT/GST reporting and compliance.
settings.help.taxes.step_1: Click 'New Tax Rate' and enter a name and percentage.
settings.help.taxes.step_2: Choose whether the tax applies to sales, purchases, or both.
settings.help.taxes.step_3: Assign the tax to the correct liability account.
settings.help.taxes.step_4: Group related taxes if your jurisdiction requires compound tax calculations.
settings.help.taxes.step_5: Save — the tax rate is now selectable on invoice and bill lines.
settings.help.warehouses.what: Warehouses are physical or virtual storage locations where you keep inventory.
settings.help.warehouses.why: Separate warehouses let you track stock levels and transfers per location.
settings.help.warehouses.step_1: Click 'New Warehouse' and enter a name and address.
settings.help.warehouses.step_2: Mark one warehouse as the primary (default) location.
settings.help.warehouses.step_3: Assign the warehouse to the relevant branches or users.
settings.help.warehouses.step_4: Save — the warehouse is now available when receiving or shipping stock.
settings.help.units.what: Units of measure define how quantities are expressed for items (e.g. kg, box, hour).
settings.help.units.why: Consistent units prevent quantity errors when buying in bulk and selling individually.
settings.help.units.step_1: Click 'New Unit' and enter a name and abbreviation.
settings.help.units.step_2: Optionally set a conversion factor if the unit relates to a base unit.
settings.help.units.step_3: Save — the unit is now selectable on item records.
settings.help.categories.what: Categories group your products and services into logical families for reporting.
settings.help.categories.why: Categorizing items makes it easier to filter reports and apply bulk pricing rules.
settings.help.categories.step_1: Click 'New Category' and enter a name.
settings.help.categories.step_2: Optionally assign a parent category to build a hierarchy.
settings.help.categories.step_3: Assign the relevant accounts to the category.
settings.help.categories.step_4: Save — the category is now available on item records.
settings.help.brands.what: Brands let you tag products with the manufacturer or brand name.
settings.help.brands.why: Brand filtering helps sales teams quickly find and present the right products.
settings.help.brands.step_1: Click 'New Brand' and enter the brand name.
settings.help.brands.step_3: Set the primary color and font for the brand.
settings.help.brands.step_4: Save — the brand is now selectable on product records.
settings.help.pricelists.what: Price lists define custom pricing tiers for different customers or sales channels.
settings.help.pricelists.why: Price lists let you offer wholesale, retail, or VIP pricing without manual overrides.
settings.help.pricelists.step_1: Click 'New Price List' and enter a name.
settings.help.pricelists.step_2: Add pricing rules — fixed price, discount percentage, or formula.
settings.help.pricelists.step_3: Assign the price list to a customer or customer group.
settings.help.pricelists.step_4: Save — the price list is applied automatically on new orders.
settings.help.payment_methods.what: Payment methods define how customers and vendors can pay or be paid (cash, card, bank transfer, etc.).
settings.help.payment_methods.why: Configuring payment methods ensures transactions are recorded against the correct account.
settings.help.payment_methods.step_1: Click 'New Payment Method' and enter a name.
settings.help.payment_methods.step_2: Select the journal (bank or cash account) linked to this method.
settings.help.payment_methods.step_3: Enable or disable the method for inbound and outbound payments.
settings.help.payment_methods.step_4: Save — the method is now available when recording payments.
settings.help.payment_terms.what: Payment terms specify when invoices are due and any early-payment discounts offered.
settings.help.payment_terms.why: Clear payment terms reduce late payments and automate due-date calculations.
settings.help.payment_terms.step_1: Click 'New Payment Term' and enter a name (e.g. Net 30).
settings.help.payment_terms.step_2: Define the due date rule — days after invoice date, end of month, etc.
settings.help.payment_terms.step_3: Optionally add an early-payment discount percentage and cutoff.
settings.help.payment_terms.step_4: Save — the term is now selectable on customer and vendor records.
settings.help.accounts.what: The chart of accounts is the complete list of ledger accounts used to record every financial transaction.
settings.help.accounts.why: A well-structured chart of accounts is the foundation of accurate financial reporting.
settings.help.accounts.step_1: Review the default accounts created during setup.
settings.help.accounts.step_2: Click 'New Account' to add any accounts specific to your business.
settings.help.accounts.step_3: Set the account type (asset, liability, equity, income, expense).
settings.help.accounts.step_4: Assign a parent account to build the hierarchy.
settings.help.accounts.step_5: Save — the account is now available in journal entries and reports.
settings.help.journals.what: Journals are the books of first entry where every financial transaction is initially recorded.
settings.help.journals.why: Separate journals (sales, purchases, bank, cash) keep transaction types organized and auditable.
settings.help.journals.step_1: Review the default journals (Sales, Purchases, Bank, Cash, Miscellaneous).
settings.help.journals.step_2: Click 'New Journal' if you need an additional book (e.g. a second bank account).
settings.help.journals.step_3: Set the journal type and link it to the correct account.
settings.help.journals.step_4: Save — the journal is now available when posting entries.
settings.help.cost_centers.what: Cost centers are organizational units used to track expenses and revenues separately.
settings.help.cost_centers.why: Cost center reporting lets management see profitability by department, project, or location.
settings.help.cost_centers.step_1: Click 'New Cost Center' and enter a name and code.
settings.help.cost_centers.step_2: Optionally assign a parent cost center for hierarchical reporting.
settings.help.cost_centers.step_3: Assign the cost center to the relevant users or departments.
settings.help.cost_centers.step_4: Save — the cost center is now selectable on journal lines.
settings.help.analytic.what: Analytic accounts provide a second dimension for tracking costs and revenues beyond the chart of accounts.
settings.help.analytic.why: Analytic accounting enables project-level or activity-level profitability analysis.
settings.help.analytic.step_1: Click 'New Analytic Account' and enter a name.
settings.help.analytic.step_2: Link it to a project, department, or activity as needed.
settings.help.analytic.step_3: Tag journal lines with the analytic account to track costs.
settings.help.analytic.step_4: Save — the analytic account can now be tagged on journal lines.
settings.help.numbering.what: Numbering sequences control the auto-generated reference numbers for documents like invoices and orders.
settings.help.numbering.why: Consistent numbering ensures every document has a unique, traceable reference.
settings.help.numbering.step_1: Select the document type whose sequence you want to configure.
settings.help.numbering.step_2: Set the prefix, starting number, and padding (e.g. INV-00001).
settings.help.numbering.step_3: Choose whether the sequence resets annually.
settings.help.numbering.step_4: Save — new documents will use the updated sequence.
settings.help.automation.what: Automation rules trigger actions automatically when defined conditions are met on records.
settings.help.automation.why: Automating repetitive tasks (sending reminders, updating statuses) saves time and reduces errors.
settings.help.automation.step_1: Click 'New Rule' and select the model (e.g. Invoice).
settings.help.automation.step_2: Define the trigger — on creation, on update, or on a scheduled time.
settings.help.automation.step_3: Add conditions to filter which records the rule applies to.
settings.help.automation.step_4: Define the action — send email, update field, create record, etc.
settings.help.automation.step_5: Activate the rule and monitor the action log.
settings.help.audit.what: The audit log records every create, update, and delete action performed by users in the system.
settings.help.audit.why: Audit trails are essential for compliance, fraud detection, and troubleshooting.
settings.help.audit.step_1: Use the date and user filters to narrow down the log.
settings.help.audit.step_2: Click any entry to see the before and after values of changed fields.
settings.help.audit.step_3: Export the log to CSV for external compliance reporting.
settings.help.jobs.what: Background jobs are scheduled or queued tasks that run automatically (e.g. sending emails, syncing data).
settings.help.jobs.why: Monitoring jobs helps you detect failures and ensure critical processes complete successfully.
settings.help.jobs.step_1: Review the list of recent job runs and their statuses.
settings.help.jobs.step_2: Click a failed job to see the error details.
settings.help.jobs.step_3: Use the retry button to re-run a failed job.
settings.help.users.what: Users are the people who have access to this system, each with their own login credentials.
settings.help.users.why: Managing users ensures only authorized people can access and modify your data.
settings.help.users.step_1: Click 'New User' and enter the person's name and email.
settings.help.users.step_2: Assign one or more roles to define what the user can see and do.
settings.help.users.step_3: Send the invitation — the user will receive an email to set their password.
settings.help.users.step_4: Deactivate a user's account when they leave the organization.
settings.help.roles.what: Roles are named permission sets that control what users can see and do in the system.
settings.help.roles.why: Role-based access control ensures users only access the data and features relevant to their job.
settings.help.roles.step_1: Click 'New Role' and enter a name (e.g. Accountant, Sales Manager).
settings.help.roles.step_2: Toggle permissions on or off for each module and action.
settings.help.roles.step_3: Review the permission summary to confirm the access level is correct.
settings.help.roles.step_4: Save and assign the role to the relevant users.
settings.help.company.what: Company settings store your organization's legal name, logo, address, and registration details.
settings.help.company.why: These details appear on all printed and emailed documents such as invoices and purchase orders.
settings.help.company.step_1: Enter your legal company name and trading name.
settings.help.company.step_2: Upload your company logo (PNG or SVG, recommended 200×60 px).
settings.help.company.step_3: Fill in the registered address and tax registration number.
settings.help.company.step_4: Save — changes take effect on all new documents immediately.
settings.help.branches.what: Branches represent physical offices, stores, or locations within your organization.
settings.help.branches.why: Branch-level tracking lets you run separate P&L reports and manage stock per location.
settings.help.branches.step_1: Click 'New Branch' and enter the branch name and address.
settings.help.branches.step_2: Assign a manager and link the branch to the correct cost center.
settings.help.branches.step_3: Assign users to the branch so they can operate from it.
settings.help.branches.step_4: Save — users can now be assigned to this branch.
settings.help.localization.what: Localization settings configure country-specific rules such as tax formats, date formats, and fiscal regulations.
settings.help.localization.why: Correct localization ensures your documents and reports comply with local legal requirements.
settings.help.localization.step_1: Select your country from the localization package list.
settings.help.localization.step_2: Review the pre-configured tax rates and chart of accounts.
settings.help.localization.step_3: Adjust any defaults that do not match your specific setup.
settings.help.localization.step_4: Save — localization rules are applied to all new transactions.
settings.help.email.what: Email settings configure the SMTP server used to send system emails such as invoices and reminders.
settings.help.email.why: A correctly configured email server ensures documents reach customers and vendors reliably.
settings.help.email.step_1: Enter your SMTP host, port, and authentication credentials.
settings.help.email.step_2: Set the 'From' name and email address that recipients will see.
settings.help.email.step_3: Click 'Test Connection' to verify the settings work.
settings.help.email.step_4: Save — the system will now send emails through your SMTP server.
settings.help.sms.what: SMS settings configure the messaging gateway used to send text messages to customers and staff.
settings.help.sms.why: SMS notifications improve response rates for payment reminders and order confirmations.
settings.help.sms.step_1: Select your SMS provider from the list.
settings.help.sms.step_2: Enter the API key or credentials provided by your SMS gateway.
settings.help.sms.step_3: Set the sender name or number.
settings.help.sms.step_4: Send a test message to verify the configuration.
settings.help.sms.step_5: Save — SMS notifications are now active.
settings.help.notifications.what: Notification settings control which in-app and email alerts are sent for system events.
settings.help.notifications.why: Timely notifications keep your team informed about approvals, overdue invoices, and other critical events.
settings.help.notifications.step_1: Browse the list of notification types (e.g. invoice overdue, approval required).
settings.help.notifications.step_2: Toggle each notification on or off per channel (in-app, email).
settings.help.notifications.step_3: Save — your notification preferences are applied immediately.
settings.help.integrations.what: Integrations connect this system to external services such as payment gateways, e-commerce platforms, and APIs.
settings.help.integrations.why: Integrations eliminate manual data entry by syncing records automatically between systems.
settings.help.integrations.step_1: Browse the available integrations and click the one you want to enable.
settings.help.integrations.step_2: Enter the API credentials or authorize via OAuth.
settings.help.integrations.step_3: Configure sync settings (frequency, direction, field mapping).
settings.help.integrations.step_4: Save and run an initial sync to import existing data.
settings.help.appearance.what: Appearance settings control the visual theme, layout, and branding of the application.
settings.help.appearance.why: Customizing the appearance aligns the system with your brand and improves user comfort.
settings.help.appearance.step_1: Choose a color theme (light, dark, or system default).
settings.help.appearance.step_2: Select a layout style from the available templates.
settings.help.appearance.step_3: Upload a custom logo if you want to replace the default.
settings.help.appearance.step_4: Save — the new appearance is applied for all users.
settings.help.security.what: Security settings manage password policies, two-factor authentication, and session controls.
settings.help.security.why: Strong security settings protect your organization's data from unauthorized access.
settings.help.security.step_1: Set the minimum password length and complexity requirements.
settings.help.security.step_2: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all or specific users.
settings.help.security.step_3: Configure session timeout to automatically log out inactive users.
settings.help.security.step_4: Review the list of active sessions and revoke any suspicious ones.
settings.help.security.step_5: Save — new security rules apply at the next login.
settings.help.backup.what: Backup & Restore lets you create snapshots of your data and restore them if something goes wrong.
settings.help.backup.why: Regular backups protect against accidental data loss, corruption, or ransomware.
settings.help.backup.step_1: Click 'Create Backup' to generate a snapshot of the current data.
settings.help.backup.step_2: Download the backup file and store it in a secure off-site location.
settings.help.backup.step_3: To restore, upload a backup file and confirm the restore operation.
settings.help.studio.what: Studio is a no-code builder that lets you customize forms, views, and workflows without writing code.
settings.help.studio.why: Studio empowers business users to adapt the system to their processes without developer involvement.
settings.help.studio.step_1: Select the model (e.g. Invoice, Contact) you want to customize.
settings.help.studio.step_2: Drag and drop fields to rearrange the form layout.
settings.help.studio.step_3: Add custom fields using the field palette on the right.
settings.help.studio.step_4: Save and preview the changes in the live application.
settings.help.docs_hub.what: The Help Center provides searchable documentation, guides, and tutorials for every feature.
settings.help.docs_hub.why: Quick access to documentation reduces support requests and helps users learn the system faster.
settings.help.docs_hub.step_1: Type a keyword in the search box to find relevant articles.
settings.help.docs_hub.step_2: Browse by category if you prefer to explore topics.
settings.help.docs_hub.step_3: Bookmark frequently used articles for quick access.
settings.help.docs_hub.step_4: Click any article to read the full guide.
settings.help.ui_gallery.what: The Layout Gallery lets you preview and switch between different UI shell layouts for the application.
settings.help.ui_gallery.why: Choosing the right layout improves navigation efficiency and matches your team's workflow preferences.
settings.help.ui_gallery.step_2: Click a layout to see a live preview.
settings.help.ui_gallery.step_3: Click 'Apply' to set the layout as the active shell for all users.

sales.invoices.help.what: Invoices are the primary sales documents sent to customers for goods or services delivered.
sales.invoices.help.why: You need invoices to record revenue, track receivables, and maintain a legal paper trail.
sales.invoices.help.step_1: Click New Invoice and select a customer from the contacts list.
sales.invoices.help.step_2: Add line items with quantities, prices, and applicable tax rates.

sales.invoices.lineItems.help.why: Each line item captures quantity, unit price, and tax to calculate the invoice total.

sales.invoices.lineItems.help.step_2: Select an item from the catalog or type a custom description.
sales.invoices.lineItems.help.step_3: Set the quantity and verify the unit price and tax rate.
